policies.name: Riders view own KYC or admin support view any
policies.qual:
((( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid) = user_id) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM users u
  WHERE ((u.id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND ((u.role = 'admin'::text) OR (u.role = 'support'::text))))))

policies.name: Allow authenticated users to view online riders
policies.qual: ((account_status = 'online'::rider_account_status_enum) OR (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid) = user_id))

policies.name: Allow riders to update their own profile
Riders can update own rider profile
Riders can view own rider profile
Users can view own rider profile
Allow travellers to view profile of searching intercity passeng
policies.qual:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM orders o
  WHERE ((o.user_id = users.id) AND (o.order_status = 'searching'::order_status_enum) AND ((o.order_type)::text ~~ 'intercity%'::text))))

policies.name: Allow travellers to view sender profile for active intercity re
policies.qual:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (intercity_requests ir
     JOIN riders r ON ((r.id = ir.traveller_id)))
  WHERE ((ir.sender_id = users.id) AND (r.user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (ir.status <> ALL (ARRAY['cancelled'::text, 'rejected'::text, 'expired'::text])))))

functions.name: is_admin
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.admins
    WHERE email = auth.email() AND is_active = true
  );
$function$
